title: Egyptian Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Italian-inspired dish made with red lentils, onions, garlic, and aromatic spices.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the red lentils, tomato paste, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the water to the pot and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30-40 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Slice the toasted bread into 1-inch pieces and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the bread with a little olive oil and toast in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
Serve the Egyptian Lentil Stew hot, garnished with toasted bread and a sprinkle of parsley, if desired.
Optional: Serve with a side of garlic bread or a green salad.
